Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack 4 Artisians and Ranchers
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
Mostly, this exists to test the ability to add music beyond the game limitations.  These three tracks [b]DO NOT[/b] replace any of the default music.  
Each was handcrafted and encoded with high quality!

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Listen to the Artisan and Ranchers Pack![/size][/color]
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/artisans-and-ranchers[/soundcloud]

Installation is easy!

[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url] and place in your Mods Folder
[*]Place the unzipped music pack into your Mods folder
[/list]
For those who want to use it in events the music IDs will be

cm:LeahHouse, cm:MarnieHouse, cm:ClintHouse
